Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 85 identities means 85 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 27%.
